description: A thin liquid stain or water-colour, sometimes mixed with size, applied to the trimmed edges of a book to tint them. It is laid on in successive light coats until the wanted depth of tone is reached.
name: edge colour

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter X, p.139. Internet Archive.
